meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Route NanoClaw agent group to local Ollama model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run AI agents locally and cut API costs

howto.what: 把 NanoClaw 中某个 agent group 的请求改发到本地 Ollama 模型,不再走 Anthropic API;之后该分组的回复由本地模型生成,且可屏蔽 api.anthropic.com 以避免意外计费。
howto.when: 当用户想把 NanoClaw 中的某个 agent group 改用本地 Ollama 模型,包括想在本地运行、降低 API 费用或试验开放权重模型时触发。

say.text: 把生产环境的 agent group 改用本地 Ollama 模型
say.note: 会读取配置并设置对应环境变量和模型。

say.text: 帮我用 qwen3-coder 替代 Anthropic API 跑这个分组
say.note: 会在共享设置里写入该模型名并重启服务。

howto.what_en: Routes a specified NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama instance instead of the Anthropic API. After applying, messages in that group are answered by the chosen local model, and api.anthropic.com can be blocked to prevent accidental charges.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to route an existing NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model, such as to run the agent locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models.

say_en.text: Switch the production agent group to a local Ollama model.
say_en.note: Updates environment variables and the model setting.

say_en.text: Run this group with qwen3-coder instead of the Anthropic API.
say_en.note: Writes the model name and restarts the service.

say_en.text: I don't want to use the Anthropic API; point this agent group to local Ollama.
say_en.note: Blocks api.anthropic.com and switches the model.
